Hi @krocard ,

Attached video and logs for reference. In the video you can observe first preroll is completed before second preroll started and video got stuck at 1st mid-roll. 

Also attaching patch for seek logic.

Hope this helps 
[issue_8349.zip](https://github.com/google/ExoPlayer/files/5700455/issue_8349.zip)

Thank you, I managed to reproduce the issue.

The issue is due to `pendingOperationAcks` being incremented even if the seek is ignored. When the seek is ignored, an updatedPlaybcak info is sent with an `operationAcks` of 0.
https://github.com/google/ExoPlayer/blob/be13805ce4e22231ae728d2710a2b8751ee5ad7c/library/core/src/main/java/com/google/android/exoplayer2/ExoPlayerImpl.java#L598-L607

This lead to ExoPlayer considering that an operation is still in flight, and `playbackInfo` is no longer updated.

We could call `incrementPendingOperationAcks(1)` on the sent `PlaybackInfoUpdate`, but I'm not sure it is the right thing to do because it also sets `hasPendingChange`, which is not true.

This regression was introduced by b1e9257de143e9f377895b63868ef47b4fc0eea9 in 2.12.0.

@icbaker could you take a look.

issue.title: Some nonlinear ads causing the player to stall

repository.name: ExoPlayer
repository.description: This project is deprecated and stale. The latest ExoPlayer code is available in https://github.com/androidx/media

issue.body:
While we are aware that mobile IMA SDK does not support nonlinear ads, we are experiencing issues with playback, if an ad server returns such ads. Observed with ExoPlayer 2.11.8 both in ExoPlayer demo app and our own app.

These steps can be used to reproduce the issue:
_1. Load the following VMAP https://devs.origin.cdn.cra.cz/ima/stuck/vmap.xml.
2. Skip the preroll or let it finish and seek immediately after the first midroll adbreak.
3. Now, most likely the skip button will not count down to 0 (keeps displaying 5) and the player becomes stuck at the end of the midroll, the last event is onAdEvent: AD_BUFFERING. This happens every time on multiple devices, so should be easy to reproduce and to get your own fresh log._

It works fine, if these nonlinear adbreaks are omitted from the VMAP, but this simulated test ad suite is structurally almost an exact copy of what our player receives in production environment from third party ad services of our customers and the content these services provide is out of our hands.

Please, take a look, but might be primarily an issue with IMA SDK itself judging by the skip button behavior in midroll.
